get.description:
Return properties for these specific service providers. Filter the results returned using the query parameters.

Reference Crypto supported service providers, Fiat supported service providers, and Bank-Linking supported service providers for a full list.

parameters.name: serviceProviders
parameters.description: A comma separated list of service providers.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: A comma separated list of service provider categories

parameters.name: accountServiceProviders
parameters.description: Filter by service providers which are configured for the account.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: A comma separated list of 2-char alpha code for supported countries.

parameters.name: fiatCurrencies
parameters.description: A comma separated list of alpha code for supported fiat currencies.

parameters.name: cryptoCurrencies
parameters.description: A comma separated list of alpha code for supported crypto currencies.

parameters.name: paymentMethodTypes
parameters.description:
A comma separated list of payment method types.

For valid return values see: Supported Payment Methods

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: A comma separated list of service provider statuses.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: A comma separated list of service provider crypto currency chains.

200.description: A List of Service Provider Properties

400.description: Bad Request : check request values and format

403.description: Unauthenticated or authenticated with insufficient access

get.summary: Get Payment Methods Available by Country
get.description:
NOTE: Currently, this API is only for crypto supported service providers. The response will contain all payment methods that can be used to purchase cryptocurrencies in the specified country.

Reference Crypto supported service providers for a full list.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The 2-char alpha code for the country. If no value is provided, payment methods for all countries will be returned

parameters.name: serviceProviders
parameters.description: A comma separated List of Service Providers to filter to. If no value is provided, payment methods for all service providers will be returned

parameters.name: accountServiceProviders
parameters.description: Set this param to true to only return service providers enabled for your account.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: A comma separated List of service provider statuses. Valid Values are: LIVE,RECENTLY_ADDED,BUILDING,TO_BE_BUILT

400.description: Bad Request : check request values and format

403.description: Unauthenticated or authenticated with insufficient access

RoutingCondition.description:
This is polymorphic based on the operator:
  • EQUALS - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • GREATER_THAN - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • GREATER_THAN_EQUALS - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • IN - MultipleValueRoutingCondition
  • LESS_THAN - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • LESS_THAN_EQUALS - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • NOT_EQUALS - SingleValueRoutingCondition
  • NOT_IN - MultipleValueRoutingCondition

Variable value formats:

  • SOURCE_AMOUNT - <3-character currency code><space><numeric amount>
    examples: USD 100, CAD 123.45

  • INSTITUTION_ID - <id>
    examples: Ntj3AwgdridJc2rtfeheku, 29KL1L2iYUV3zUCoSHhwvr

  • COUNTRY_CODE - <2-character country code>
    examples: US, CA

  • PAYMENT_METHOD_TYPE - <payment method>
    examples: VISA, APPLE_PAY

ServiceProviderPreference.description:
This is polymorphic based on the algorithm:
  • EQUAL_DISTRIBUTION - ListServiceProviderPreference
  • ORDERED - ListServiceProviderPreference
  • SINGLE - SingleServiceProviderPreference
  • WEIGHTED_DISTRIBUTION - WeightedServiceProviderPreference
  • HEALTH - OptionalListServiceProviderPreference
